MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 15

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 8

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 73

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 10

2. D — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. B — 10

4. D — 15
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144
4. c² = 225
5. c = 15
Final Answer: 15 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

5. C — 8
Working:

2. Substitute values: x = 16 − 8
3. x = 8
Final Answer: x = 8
